hints.title: Single Character Edge Case
hints.text: A string of length 1 can never be broken out of being a palindrome because any 1-character string is palindromic. Return empty string.

hints.title: Greedy First Non-a
hints.text: To make the string lexicographically smallest, change the first character that is not "a" into "a".

hints.title: Skip Odd Center
hints.text: Do not change the center character of an odd-length string, as doing so maintains palindromic symmetry. If all eligible are "a", change the last character to "b".

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all replacements and checking each with palindrome validation takes O(26 * N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting the first half left-to-right makes the replacement decision in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate spots the odd center edge case and fallback to changing the last character to "b".
complexity.notes: Only need to inspect up to N // 2 characters.
